# The Bandit

> The Bandit is South Africa's #1 magician: a Johannesburg-based comedy magician, pickpocket entertainer and certified hypnotist who performs at corporate events, weddings, galas, private parties and stage shows across South Africa and internationally.

Based in Johannesburg, South Africa. Performs across South Africa and internationally. More than 20 years of experience and 100+ corporate brands as clients. Trained privately by Troye the Mentalist (South Africa) and Gregory Wilson (USA). Bookings: use the enquiry form on the website, email info@thebandit.co.za or phone +27 87 943 9435. The team replies to enquiries to discuss the event.

Last updated: 2026-10-28

Important notes:

- Pricing is not published on the website. To get a quote, send an enquiry through the booking form, email or phone with the event type, date and venue.
- The pickpocketing is entertainment: wallets, watches, belts and ties are taken from willing audience members and always returned.
- Hypnotism is done live on stage with willing volunteers.
- The website is a single page; the links below point to its sections.

## Services and booking

- [Services](https://thebandit.co.za/#services): The six offerings: close-up and roaming magic, professional stage shows, pickpocket entertainment, hypnotism, MC services, and family and promotional shows, each with a description and tags.
- [Book The Bandit](https://thebandit.co.za/#contact): Booking enquiry form (name, email, company, event date, event type such as corporate function, wedding, private party, trade show, comedy club or theatre, festival or concert) and the direct phone number.
- [Showreel video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KXtSX7TxY1w): The Bandit's magic showreel on YouTube, the quickest way to see what a performance looks like.

## Credibility

- [Clients and brands](https://thebandit.co.za/#clients): Brands he has performed for, including ABSA, Toyota, MTN, Anglo American, Discovery, Barclays, FNB, KFC, Land Rover, Sanlam, Vodacom, Sasol, British American Tobacco, Centriq Insurance, Dainfern College and MNI.
- [Reviews](https://thebandit.co.za/#testimonials): Testimonials from Darren "Whackhead" Simpson (South African radio and comedy), Shakira Carlsen (Mercedes-Benz) and Mahlatse (Gautrain).
- [Venues](https://thebandit.co.za/#venues): Comedy clubs, casinos, theatres, estates and resorts he has performed at, including Montecasino, Emperors Palace, Sun City, Steyn City and the Joburg Theatre.
